snippet.title: Nightmare: Reimagined Beginning - Available Now!
snippet.description:
*Nightmare: Reimagined Beginning* is a remake of my first game Nightmare. 
The game was made completely from scratch and the old stuff that appeared here was recreated and refreshed. 
Everything that made the original terrible has been fixed in the remake

*Link to game:* https://gamejolt.com/games/nightmare_reimagined_beginning/529235

Music: *Pyromaniac radio* - Mr.Kuabster (Available to listen on gamejolt and use with credit)
